content: Next.js App Router: revalidatePath invalidates the client-side Router Cache for a route (coarse); revalidateTag invalidates specific fetch Data Cache entries tagged via next.tags (fine-grained). Revalidation is NOT automatic on Server Action completion — must be called explicitly inside the action. Prefer revalidateTag only when fetches actually use the Next Data Cache; irrelevant when fetches use cache:'no-store' (nothing tagged to invalidate).
